description: MUMmer 3.23 mummerplot (perl script 3.5): the gnuplot plot of the alignments of a nucmer / promer .delta, a .cluster (nucmer --nodelta), a mummer -c output (.out; use -c -b -L) or a show-tiling file (.tiling; coverage plot): the data files <prefix>.fplot (forward hits sorted by percent similarity, 'sR sQ sim' per end of an alignment, blocks separated by two empty lines), <prefix>.rplot (reverse hits), <prefix>.hplot (highlighted hits: breakpoints with breakLength = -b, SNP positions with snp = -S through show-snps) and the script <prefix>.gp (terminal x11 / postscript / png with --x11 --postscript --png or terminal = -t, size small / medium / large, ranges, tics of several sequences, grid, labels, the line styles, the plot or splot command; color / coverage / title / xRange / yRange / layout options) - and, for delta input with filter (-f) or layout (-l, --fat; needs rFile / qFile), the filtered delta file <prefix>.filter (delta-filter -r -q). For delta and cluster input the sequence files named in the first line of the file are read (files: name -> FASTA text) to get the lengths and offsets of the sequences, rFile / qFile (-R / -Q) name files with an ordered set of sequences (a multi-FASTA file, or lines 'id length [+|-]'), idR / idQ (-r / -q) plot one sequence. The script then runs gnuplot: gnuplotCommand is the command line it runs (the rendering - .ps / .png / the x11 window - is not part of the text output); stdout holds the line of gnuplot --version (gnuplotVersion; gnuplotStatus 0 = found, -1 = not found, other = outdated), messages the progress lines and warnings (multiple terminals / sizes, -f -l -S with non-delta input, ports of non-x11 plots, overlaid sequences, 'Forking mouse listener' and the connection warnings of the listener of the x11 plot with rPort / qPort). A die of the script (invalid terminal / size / range, empty or unrecognised match file, no alignment data, an unreadable -R / -Q file, a line that cannot be parsed) is reported on messages with a non-zero exitCode (the status the program returns is the stale errno of its last system call: the tool returns 2). When equal lengths or offsets make perl's hash order decide the layout of several sequences the program's own output differs from run to run; the port uses the order of first appearance. Byte for byte equal to the installed mummerplot on 330 + runs (every input type, every option) and 1 000 more random runs.

match.description: The text of the match file (.delta, .cluster, mummer -c .out or .tiling).

files.description: The files the script reads besides the match file, by name: the sequence files named in the first line of a delta / cluster file and the -R / -Q files (FASTA text or lists of 'id length [+|-]').

matchName.description: The file name of the match file as given to the script (printed in the messages; default out.delta).

breakLength.description: -b: highlight alignments with breakpoints further than this many nucleotides from the nearest sequence end.

color.description: --color / --nocolor: colour the plot lines by percent similarity (true) or turn all colour off (false).

coverage.description: -c / --nocoverage: draw a reference coverage plot (default for tiling input).

filter.description: -f: show only the best alignments of a delta file (delta-filter -r -q), delta input only.

layout.description: -l: lay a delta multiplot out in an intelligible fashion (needs rFile / qFile), delta input only.

prefix.description: -p: prefix of the output files (default out).

rFile.description: -R: file (a key of files) with an ordered set of reference sequences.

qFile.description: -Q: file (a key of files) with an ordered set of query sequences.

rPort.description: -rport: port to send the reference id and position to on a mouse double click (x11 plots).

snp.description: -S: highlight the SNPs (delta input; reads the sequence files).

fat.description: --fat: lay out by the fattest alignment only (implies layout).

gnuplotStatus.description: The status of 'gnuplot --version': 0 found (default), -1 not found, other = outdated.

files.description: The files of the script by name (.fplot, .rplot, .hplot, .gp, .filter).

stdout.description: Standard output (the version line of gnuplot).

exitCode.description: The exit status (0, or non-zero after a die).

gnuplotCommand.description: The gnuplot command line the script runs.

errors.message: Match file text cannot be null or empty
ERROR: Could not read <file>, Unrecognized file type

examples.name: A PNG plot of one alignment

files.demo.gp:
set terminal png tiny size 800,800
set output "demo.png"
set size 1,1
set grid
unset key
set border 15
set tics scale 0
set xlabel "ref"
set ylabel "qry"
set format "%.0f"
set mouse format "%.0f"
set mouse mouseformat "[%.0f, %.0f]"
set xrange [1:260]
set yrange [1:240]
set style line 1  lt 1 lw 3 pt 6 ps 1
set style line 2  lt 3 lw 3 pt 6 ps 1
set style line 3  lt 2 lw 3 pt 6 ps 1
plot \
 "demo.fplot" title "FWD" w lp ls 1, \
 "demo.rplot" title "REV" w lp ls 2

output.messages:
Reading delta file x.delta
Writing plot files demo.fplot, demo.rplot
Writing gnuplot script demo.gp
Rendering plot demo.png
